name: receipt_disbursement_integrity
preconditionSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.receipts') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.disbursements') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.financial_movements') IS NOT NULL AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('bt_receipts__immutable','bt_disbursements__immutable','bt_financial_movements__cash_source_singleton') AND NOT tgisinternal)=3 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls back the 09.03 integrity functions and triggers. After success use a forward-only migration for changes.
